source_caption:
Don’t Give The Serum To Sam WilSON. 

SAM WILSON becoming Captain America was never about inheriting Steve Rogers’ strength — it was about carrying forward the ideals behind the shield. Without super-soldier abilities, Sam has to rely on his courage, instincts, and belief in people, making him a different kind of leader in a world filled with gods, monsters, and superhumans. In Avengers: Doomsday, standing alongside some of the most powerful beings on Earth, Sam represents the humanity that the Avengers are supposed to protect. He may not be the strongest among them, but he’s the one who has to bring them together when everything falls apart.

A shield doesn’t make a man Captain America. What he stands for does.
